item.title: Selecting a suitable dataset
item.description: Im tasked with writing a short(<20pages) report, applying statistical tools I've learned about in a course to some dataset of my choice. But I'm having a really hard time in selecting one, could someone help me in that? (The course was mainly on Bayesian techniques, ie Laplace Approximation, Acceptance-rejection method, Gibbs Sampling and Metropolis-Hastings)
